notes.title: Major Overhaul | Demo Version 1.2
notes.notes:
In preparation for Next Fest 2025, I am bringing a whole new load of changes to the demo:

Added a new weapon

Added new rooms

Added new relics

Touched up the tutorial

UI and GFX redesign

Added new sound effects

More settings

New enemy: the skeleton

Controller support

Bugfixes

...and more! Happy exploring.

notes.title: Introducing: Items for towers | Demo Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Changelog

 MAJOR FEATURE: All relic items can now be placed in towers to function the same way they do in players, adding thousands of upgrades and interactions to discover
 Further improved tutorial experience
 Bug fixes
